gates.scope: home_outcome PASS needs: plan preflight PASS, the trajectory fully executed, grasp never lost, final joints within max_home_joint_error_rad of q_home after settle_s, final tool body pose within the translation/rotation bounds of the tool pose measured right after the reset pregrasp settle, grasp slip/rotation since settling within the bounds (the GraspMonitor warning gates), zero material cut-label changes, zero native unintended tool contacts (palm/table/fixture/other), and the measured joint path passing the same geometric clearance check.

home_outcome_detail.scope: Physical return-to-home only; reported separately from the task outcome

material_vs_board.scope: Particle centres (not the contact shell) vs the board top (workpiece-local z = 0), every recorded frame

forces.board_reaction_inferred_scope: Quasi-static: F_board = -(F_fingers - F_fingers,free) - F_material,applied (native tensor finger/palm forces of the last substep of each control step; inertia neglected, so values during fast motion are not board forces).

displacement.scope: Mass-weighted means of the recorded particle centres (privileged material state, evaluation only), workpiece-local frame; the per-operation interval runs from the last recorded frame before the armed segment to the first frame after the operation (record_every steps).

profiling.note: robot_physics_wall_s of the runner spans the PhysX substeps through the end of step() (material and surface included); robot_and_other_ms_derived = step - material - surface_update

geometry.scope:
the final staged specimen mesh ``/World/ContinuousSpecimen`` of ``final_live_scene.usda``
(WORLD; the rendered surface, never the collider) against the final recorded particle state
(``physics_state.npz`` last frame) with ``surface_metrics_v1.surface_report`` in current space. The Native record
holds no deformation gradient F, so the side locus is translation-only (F = identity), and the reference-space
pull-back is not computed. The locus is the labelled link midpoint for every run (comparable A vs B); B runs also
report the recorder Hermite locus (``cut_events_log.npy``; reference = workpiece-local lattice, as the recorder).

self_intersection.method: segment-triangle crossing among vertex-disjoint neighbouring triangles (bounded sample)
